Peninsula_Applicability: Standard IPCC AR6 forcing benchmark. Limitation: 8 km requires topographic downscaling to resolve Peninsula spine.
Integration_Role_in_Phase5: Primary multi-scenario atmospheric driving forcing for 2100 forward projections.

Temporal_Horizon: Multi-decadal climatology and decadal trend fields
Peninsula_Applicability: Direct observation of warm Upper CDW flooding West Antarctic Peninsula vs cold Filchner-Ronne/Weddell waters.
Integration_Role_in_Phase5: Calibrates the zero-epoch ocean thermal forcing anchor for sub-shelf cavity melt formulas.

Dataset_Name: BedMachine Antarctica V4.1 Subglacial Topography & Basal Troughs
Physical_Domain_Variables: Bed elevation (bed), ice thickness, surface elevation, rock mask, ice mask, firn air content, bed uncertainty

Integration_Role_in_Phase5: Provides retrograde bed slope geometry and water depth at grounding lines (h_GL) for flux formulas.

Physical_Domain_Variables: Surface velocity magnitude (v), vector components (vx, vy), error fields, annual flowlines
